source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "self-help housing" OR "slum upgrading" OR "slum redevelopment" OR "sites and services"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"self-help housing" OR "slum upgrading" OR "slum redevelopment" OR "sites and services",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("self-help housing" OR "sites and services" OR "slum redevelopment" OR "slum upgrading")
